title: Reflexivity outside a finite interval
statement: Let $b,K$ be natural numbers, and let $M$ be a Boolean-valued function on the integers. The function $M$ agrees with itself at every integer that is not equal to $b+v$ for any natural number $v<K$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued function on the integers
